cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hand me the hall key and tell the committee I decide what happens next. I'll take things smoothly from here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I just give you the key? My retirement taxi is waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sentence on your way out, then. I'll carry your bag. The committee needs to hear who makes the decisions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're outside asking me whether Saturday's dance is canceled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Tell them I decide that now, then ask me in front of them. You can keep walking to the taxi; I'll answer from beside you and take the questions off your hands.
